author: Zintenka
body:
So i went through a random stroll through the repository and found out a bunch of syntaxes that could prove useful in nebula.

Void-build: False: For special maps that I want to make that test players' cannon skills and could prove to improve them.

kits: Its the nexus kits. Could we put this in nebula so that we can be allowed to make a kit-based nebula map easier to code?

weights: This is the SG thingy, according to what i read... the higher the weight like: 1.0 or 2.0, the more occurrence there will be.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Um, for kits don't use a kits: thing. Use an import and write it where the directory of the file you want to import is. If you want special kits added to the repo, contact me and I'll review it. An example of this is tnt.yml, where you get a loadout of TNT. Kits like nexus (choosing with a star and doing /kit) doesn't work in nebula.

Void-build works for nebula, yes.

Weights does not currently function with nebula. It's just for SG, since it randomly applies things to chests.

replies.body: You don't need an import for kits, but kits are not supported like that on most games. You should just use signs and give loadout triggers.
